div.div: فِيهِ تَيْسِيَّةٌ [In him is goatishness]: some say ↓ تَيْسُوسِيَّةٌ , [in the TA تُيُوسِيَّةٌ, but the former, which is found in the L as well as in the S and K, seems, from what here follows, to be the right,] (S, L, K,) and [in like manner, for كَيْفِيَّةٌ they say] كَيْفُوفِيَّةٌ, but [ J says] I know not what is the truth thereof: (S:) the former word is preferable. (O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
